model_annotations.Bulgarian: Тази стълбовидна диаграма показва връзката между степента на разреждане и перплексността за два различни подхода, Per-Output и Per-Layer. Хоризонталната ос представя степените на разреждане като процент, в диапазона от 10% до 80%, със стъпка от 10%, докато вертикалната ос показва перплексността на логаритмична скала от 10^0 до 10^3. За всяка степен на разреждане са дадени по две стълби, едното в синьо за Per-Output и другото в оранжево за Per-Layer. При 10% разреждане и двете стълби са близо до 2, като синята е малко по-ниска; при 80% разреждане синята стълба достига около 600, а оранжевата - малко над 800. За всички междинни точки на разреждане стойностите на перплексността се увеличават, като при по-високите степени на разреждане разликите между двете групи стават по-значителни.
model_annotations.Chinese:
This bar graph displays the relationship between sparsity rate and perplexity for two categories: Per-Output and Per-Layer. The horizontal axis represents the sparsity rate, labeled with percentages ranging from 10% to 80% in increments of 10%, with a linear scale. The vertical axis represents perplexity, labeled with values from 10^0 to 10^3, also in a logarithmic scale, with major ticks at 10^0, 10^1, 10^2, and 10^3, and minor ticks at each power of 10. 

The Per-Output category is represented by blue bars, while the Per-Layer category is represented by orange bars. At 10% sparsity rate, both categories have a perplexity of approximately 2. At 20% and 30% sparsity rates, the perplexity remains around 2-3 for both categories. At 40% sparsity rate, the perplexity for Per-Output is around 4, while for Per-Layer it is around 3. The perplexity for Per-Output increases to around 8 at 50% sparsity rate and 20 at 60% sparsity rate. For Per-Layer, the perplexity at 50% sparsity rate is around 5 and at 60% sparsity rate is around 8. At 70% sparsity rate, Per-Output perplexity is around 50 and Per-Layer perplexity is around 100. At 80% sparsity rate, Per-Output perplexity reaches around 600 and Per-Layer perplexity reaches around 800. The bars are ordered by increasing sparsity rate, with no additional visual emphasis on any of the bars.
model_annotations.English: This bar chart illustrates the relationship between sparsity rate and perplexity for two categories, Per-Output and Per-Layer. The horizontal axis represents the sparsity rate, labeled with percentages from 10% to 80% in increments of 10%, with a linear scale. The vertical axis represents perplexity, labeled with values from 10^1 to 10^3 on a logarithmic scale. The Per-Output category is represented by blue bars, and the Per-Layer category is represented by orange bars. The bars are grouped by sparsity rate, with each group containing one blue bar and one orange bar. The approximate perplexity values for the shortest and tallest bars are as follows: for Per-Output, approximately 4 at 10% sparsity and around 600 at 80% sparsity; for Per-Layer, approximately 5 at 10% sparsity and around 900 at 80% sparsity. The bars are not sorted in a specific way, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond their color and grouping.
model_annotations.German: Dieses Balkendiagramm zeigt die Beziehung zwischen Perplexity und Sparsity Rate für zwei Kategorien, Per-Output und Per-Layer. Die horizontale Achse stellt den Sparsity Rate dar, der in Schritten von 10% zwischen 10% und 80% reicht. Die vertikale Achse stellt die Perplexity dar, wobei der Wertebereich von etwa 5 bis 500 reicht und eine logarithmische Skala verwendet wird. Die Balken für Per-Output sind blau, während die Balken für Per-Layer orange sind. Jeder Balken repräsentiert den Wert der Perplexity für einen bestimmten Sparsity Rate. Die Balken nehmen mit steigendem Sparsity Rate zu. Die niedrigsten Werte für beide Kategorien liegen bei etwa 5, bei einem Sparsity Rate von 10%. Der höchste Wert für Per-Output liegt bei etwa 480 und für Per-Layer bei etwa 520, beide bei einem Sparsity Rate von 80%. Die Balken sind nicht sortiert und es gibt keine Hervorhebung einzelner Balken.
